title: Adjusting Inventory (Desktop and RF)

children:
The term "inventory adjustment" refers to adding/subtracting an item quantity from a location's inventory (outside of a pick or a putaway action). Adjustments allow you to quickly respond to unexpected location activity 
 in real time. You can make adjustments by loose item quantities as well as whole license plates.

Adjustment 
 types are associated with adjustment classes and are user-configurable. 
 It is this class that determines how the system will process the adjustment 
 type. Because the class determines how the system will process inventory, 
 you can create as many adjustment types as you need. This allows you to 
 use specialized adjustment types for different kinds of inventory or locations. For each adjustment type, you can 
 also determine if can be applied to frozen locations. Also, to minimize errors, 
 you can set minimum and maximum quantity values per adjustment type.

You can also have the system generate work instructions for certain 
 types of inventory adjustments (performed from the desktop). This allows adjusted quantities 
 to not show up as available in 
 a location until the quantity is actually present (on 
 hand) in the location.
The status of allocated inventory can be changed in the shipping and receiving dock.
From the Lot insight screen, user will not be able to perform inventory adjustment/status change/transfer when the updated inventory is linked with inventory attributes.
While editing lot information, user will be able to change status/expiration date. This change will be updated across all inventory records for the item/company/lot in the system.

Using Inventory Attributes With Inventory Adjustments

Using Inventory Attributes With Inventory Adjustments...

If you try to perform an adjustment (Desktop or RF) to/from a location that has inventory attributes, 
the system will display an error when selecting a location inventory record from the Inventory Insight screen that represents multiple inventory attributes.  If the "Show All License Plates And/Or Inventory Attributes" checkbox on the insight screen is selected, then the system will adjust inventory for the selected record.
The system will add/subtract inventory at the location without inventory attributes when performing a positive/negative adjustment through the Inventory Adjustment Desktop menu.
When you access RF inventory management directly from the RF Main Menu screen, the system does not adjust or change the status for inventory linked to inventory attributes.

When changing inventory status, the system will notify the user that the inventory does not exist when the system has one or more location inventory records linked to inventory attributes. See the topic

Any time you perform an adjustment from system menu for a location having inventory with and without attribute or inventory with different attributes, system always brings up the oldest record and the adjustments are done to the record that was shown.
